app.name: Auria
landing.hero.subhead: No followers. Real reputation, real encounters, real projects.
landing.download.title: Take Auria with you.
landing.manifesto.title: Social taught us to scroll through time. Auria teaches you to seize it.
landing.manifesto.body: No vanity metrics: only real reputation, real encounters, real projects. And one question at the heart of every profile: what is your dream?
landing.pillars.title: Six pillars, one seamless experience.
landing.pillars.community.name: Community
landing.pillars.community.desc: An evolutionary feed: ideas, business, art, science, inspiration.
landing.pillars.live.name: Auria Live
landing.pillars.live.desc: Online and live events: business, training, wellbeing, music, art.
landing.pillars.momenti.name: Moments
landing.pillars.momenti.desc: Intelligent networking: the right person at the right moment.
landing.pillars.costellazioni.name: Constellations
landing.pillars.costellazioni.desc: Collaborations and shared projects: single stars becoming visible patterns.
landing.pillars.marketplace.name: Marketplace
landing.pillars.marketplace.desc: Services, consulting, products, courses and talents.
landing.pillars.circle.name: Auria Circle
landing.pillars.circle.desc: The premium membership: belonging, not a paywall.
landing.aura.quote: You don't count followers. You kindle your Aura.
landing.aura.body: Aura is a reputation that grows only through real, verifiable actions. It can't be bought, inflated or faked.
landing.sogno.body: Every profile carries its owner's dream, and a button: "make this dream happen". The dream stops being private and becomes a collective project.
landing.daivita.quote: Here dreams aren't just told. They really come true.
landing.daivita.body: Every year the community concretely realizes the dream of one or more of its members. Thousands of people, one dream made real.
notFound.title: This place doesn't exist
notFound.body: The page you're looking for isn't here. Head back to the start.
cookie.notice: We only use a language cookie and anonymous stats.
landing.preview.caption: Available for iPhone and Android.
landing.meta.description: Auria: real reputation, real encounters, real projects. Not a social network — a new evolution of digital communities.
landing.nome.quote: Alone, time is a circle. Together, it is the dawn rising between two circles.
landing.nome.body: Auria is born from two Latin roots — aurum, gold, and aurora, the dawn — and it is also the aura, the presence that surrounds every person. It is Kairos: the moment that matters, the light that rises in the space between two circles.
landing.problem.title: Social keeps you circling, alone.
landing.problem.follower: Followers ≠ trust — numbers don't tell you who is reliable.
landing.problem.scroll: Infinite scroll — time consumed without creating anything real.
landing.problem.networking: Shallow networking — thousands of contacts, zero real collaborations.
landing.problem.tools: Fragmented tools — community, events and projects live apart.
landing.problem.target: Too professional for Instagram, too human for LinkedIn. Auria is the space that was missing.
landing.stars.title: Badges are earned, never chosen.
landing.stars.ambasciatore.desc: Expands the community in the world.
